name: wcag-enforcer
description: After each Write or Edit to .tsx, .jsx, .html, .vue or .css files, runs eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, axe-core and a WCAG 2.2 AA contrast check, and hands Claude every failure with file, line and rule to fix before it moves on.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the accessibility checks on or off.

configFile.title: Project config file
configFile.description: JSON file, relative to the project, whose keys override these options (enabled, extensions, eslint, eslintCommand, eslintRulePrefixes, axe, nodeCommand, contrast, blockStopUntilFixed, timeoutMs).

extensions.title: Checked file extensions
extensions.description: Comma-separated extensions checked after a Write or Edit.

eslintCommand.title: ESLint command
eslintCommand.description: How to run the project's ESLint (its config must enable eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, or eslint-plugin-vuejs-accessibility for .vue).

blockStopUntilFixed.title: Hold the turn until fixed
blockStopUntilFixed.description: When Claude tries to finish with failures still open, send it back to fix them (at most twice in a row).
